LanguageData.FB_FleshBaitPod.label: flesh bait pod
LanguageData.FB_FleshBaitPod.description: A small rooted pod that grows a tempting flesh-sprout. Hungry wild animals may treat the sprout as food; when they begin feeding, the pod borrows a free colony-heart grasping slot and tightens root tendrils around the prey.
LanguageData.FB_FleshBaitSprout.label: flesh bait sprout
LanguageData.FB_FleshBaitSprout.description: A short-lived lure sprout grown inside a flesh bait pod. Its tissue mimics green matter and fresh meat well enough to draw hungry wild animals.
